title: Nvidia insiders say Jensen Huang was prone to wild office tantrums, which a source says some employees were surprised hadn't leaked before his public downfall (Thomas Barrabi/New York Post)
summary: Thomas Barrabi / New York Post: Nvidia insiders say Jensen Huang was prone to wild office tantrums, which a source says some employees were surprised hadn't leaked before his public downfall — Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was prone to wild temper tantrums at the office, according to company insiders …
